name: The Swarm Grows
label: Quest
description: The Swarm Grows: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So, Korran has come to a similar conclusion about these insects--they seem to be a larger threat than we assumed.

A few days ago a hunter returned to me from Thousand Needles nearly dead. He was with a raiding party sent to drive a dwarven excavation team out of the Shimmering Flats. During the attack, more of these insects erupted from a cave in the dig site and nearly killed the party.
They were led by Moktar Krin, and they've taken refuge on the border of the Shimmering Flats. Bring him this note.

clips.title: Progress
paras: War brings my group and I to the Shimmering Flats, adventurer. What brings you here?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Don't mind the thundering echoes off the mountains' walls. The goblins and gnomes are out among the Flats racing one another in atrocities created by what they call science. There are bigger threats here in Thousand Needles, one of which killed more than half my war party.
But we remain here until we hear word from Belgrom in Orgrimmar. Until then, we hold our position here, and stay vigilant.
